MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, AUGUST 14, 2025
  4900 E. 7TH ST.
  RECREATION PARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Avis Atkins McPhail, Commissioner  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Robert Blair, Commissioner  Theresa Marino, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  TAMALYN.SAYRE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55946  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, July 10, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55947  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Department of
  Economic Development on Long Beach Lifeguard Tower advertising.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55948  Recommendation to receive and file a concession status report regarding “Grill
  ‘Em All” located at 5411 E. Ocean Blvd., Long Beach, CA 90803.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55949  Recommendation to support the proposed FY26 Slip Fee Increase in accordance
  with the City Council Action of April 15, 2025, related to the issuance of the Marina
  Revenue Refunding Bonds, Series 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55950  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-55951  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, AUGUST 14, 2025
  4900 E. 7TH ST.
  RECREATION PARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 2:30 PM

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon the
day prior to the meeting.
